PARA.TITLE: HDD Navigation Picture Quality Adjustment Mode Functions

ITEM.PTXT: By pressing the "Picture Quality/Off" panel switch, the screen changes to the picture quality adjustment mode screen, where picture quality can be adjusted.

On NTSC video display screens such as TV, 4 items (tint, color depth, contrast and brightness) can be adjusted; on RGB video display screens such as the navigation screen, contrast and brightness can be adjusted.
